title: Equations
summary: What equations are, solving by inspection and algebraically, equivalent equations, fractions, brackets, formulas and word problems.

cards.title: Introduction to equations
cards.rule: An equation says two things are equal. The solution makes it true.

cards.title: Solving by inspection
cards.rule: Ask: what number makes this true?

cards.title: Equivalent equations
cards.rule: Do the same to both sides and the equation stays balanced.

cards.title: Solving algebraically
cards.rule: Undo each operation in reverse order, then check by substituting.

cards.title: Equations with fractions
cards.rule: Multiply both sides to clear the fraction.

cards.title: Using formulas
cards.rule: Substitute what you know, then solve for what's left.

cards.title: Solving problems
cards.rule: Use a letter for the unknown, write an equation, solve it, answer in words.
lines: A number plus 9 is 21: \(x + 9 = 21\), so the number is 12
